name: extraterrestrials

phase_0.boundary_condition: the cosmological horizon and the limits of signal propagation

VINIT.justification: the uninitialized state of matter before biological organization occurs

TANCH.justification: the terminal boundary that determines the survival or extinction of a civilization

AFWD.justification: the directed transformation from simple chemical precursors to complex organisms

AREV.justification: the reverse transformation where biological or technological systems return to equilibrium

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of spatial coordinates to bridge stellar systems

IMSCRIB.justification: a system that recognizes its own blueprint to produce an identical copy

FSPLIT.justification: the division of potential life into biological and technological paths

FFUSE.justification: the reunification of disparate evolutionary paths into a single communicative exchange

EVALT.justification: the affirmative identification of a non-natural origin

EVALF.justification: the negative result of a search for intelligence

ENGAGR.justification: the simultaneous presence of high probability and zero evidence

IFIX.justification: the permanent irreversible fixation of a biological presence in geological strata

phase_3.false_description: absence of life within a surveyed volume
phase_3.both_description: the state of an unobserved signal that may be noise or message

steps.domain_action: initialize the prebiotic chemical environment of a candidate exoplanet
drive the synthesis of complex organic molecules toward cellular life
establish the first self-replicating genetic sequence
record the biological emergence in the planetary crust
branch the evolutionary path into biological and technological trajectories
identify the presence of atmospheric oxygen and methane as biosignatures
advance the biological branch toward tool use and radio transmission
chain the development of energy capture to interstellar signaling
encounter the absence of detectable radio emissions in the local cluster
experience the collapse of a civilization back into planetary dust
hold the contradiction of the Fermi Paradox where life should be visible but is not
reunite the biological and technological data into a single contact event
recognize the extraterrestrial other as a reflection of universal physical laws
archive the first contact event in the permanent history of the species
seal the system within the limits of the observable universe

phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the cosmic timescale and stellar lifespans
phase_5.alfs_store: the laws of thermodynamics and nuclear physics

phase_6.post_cycle_state: high entropy waste heat and cosmic background radiation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the local decrease in entropy through life is offset by stellar dissipation
